entities.summary: Francis Mary Paul Libermann was a French Jewish convert to the Catholic Church. He became a religious priest in the Congregation of the Holy Spirit and is best known for founding the Society of the Holy Heart of Mary, which later merged with the Spiritans. He was declared venerable by Pope Pius IX in February 1910.
